flameBreath.name: Shotgun Pyro
flameBreath.description: Replace {{aqua:Flame Burst}} with {{aqua:Flame Breath}}, which has 2 charges. Replace {{aqua:Time Warp}} with {{aqua:Time Surge}}.

burstChain.name: Burst Chain

dimensionalWarp.name: Dimensional Warp
dimensionalWarp.description: Gain {{energy}} max energy. You will be warped back at {{heal;%}} health upon taking lethal damage. Reduce the duration of {{aqua:Time Warp}} by {{ticks}} but gain {{speed;%}} movement speed and {{damage;%}} damage for the duration. Warping back from lethal damage does not drop the flag.

portal.name: Portal
portal.description: Replace {{aqua:Time Warp}} with {{aqua:Portal}}. Increase the crit chance of {{aqua:Fireball}} by {{damage;%}} but reduce the optimal range by {{blocks}}.

arcaneShatter.name: Arcane Shatter
arcaneShatter.description: Gain {{energy}} energy per melee hit and {{heal}} max health. When {{aqua:Arcane Shield}} breaks, deal {{damage;%}} more damage and stun enemies within {{blocks}} for {{ticks}}.

frostMissile.name: Frost Missile
frostMissile.description: Reduce the energy cost of {{aqua:Frostbolt}} by {{energy}}, the damage by {{damage;%}}, increase the slowness inflicted by {{speed;%}} and direct hits increase the slowness by an additional {{speed;%}}.

blizzardBreath.name: Blizzard Breath
blizzardBreath.description: {{aqua:Freezing Breath}} reduces the cooldown of all your skills by {{ticks;%}} for each enemy hit and grants immunity to knockback and stun for {{ticks}}. Replace {{aqua:Time Warp}} with {{aqua:Time Surge}}. Reduce the cooldowns, energy costs, and healing/shield granted by {{aqua:Time Surge}} and {{aqua:Arcane Shield}} by {{blue;%}}

steadfastWarp.name: Steadfast Warp
steadfastWarp.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Reduce the absorption of {{aqua:Arcane Shield}} by {{damageReduction;%}}. Reduce the healing of {{aqua:Time Warp}} by {{heal;%}}, but you heal for the greater of its normal amount and your pre-Warp health, up to a maximum of {{heal}}, and it grants knockback immunity for its duration. After {{ticks}}, you can recast to instantly warp back.

chillyAura.name: Chilly Aura
chillyAura.description: {{aqua:Ice Barrier}} now slows enemies within {{blocks}} by {{speed;%}} and deals {{damage;%}} of their maximum health every {{ticks}}. Ice Barrier reduces melee attackers' speed by an additional {{speed;%}}.

iceBlock.name: Ice Block
iceBlock.description: Increase the duration of {{aqua:Ice Barrier}} by {{ticks}}. {{aqua:Ice Barrier}} can be recasted after {{ticks}}, reducing the duration by {{ticks}} and becoming {{aqua:Ice Block}}. {{aqua:Ice Block}} prevents jumping, tremendously reduces movement speed, but prevents knockback and grants {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction.

arcaneRecluse.name: Arcane Recluse
arcaneRecluse.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Increase the duration of {{aqua:Arcane Shield}} by {{ticks}} and the absorption by {{damageReduction;%}}.

typhoonBolt.name: Typhoon Bolt
typhoonBolt.description: Increase the healing of {{aqua:Water Bolt}} by {{heal;%}}.

syringe.name: Syringe
syringe.description: Reduce the healing of {{aqua:Water Bolt}} by {{heal;%}}, but increase the direct hit multiplier by {{heal;%}}. {{aqua:Water Bolt}} direct hits grant hit allies and the user {{speed;%}} speed for {{ticks}}.

divinePurification.name: Divine Purification
divinePurification.description: {{aqua:Water Breath}} now cleanses strong debuffs and grants those healed immunity to all debuffs for {{ticks}}. Reduce its cooldown by {{ticks;%}} and the energy cost by {{energy;%}}. {{aqua:Arcane Shield}} costs {{energy}} energy.

clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
clairvoyance.description: Replace {{aqua:Time Warp}} with {{aqua:Clairvoyance}}. Gain {{energy}} max energy. Reduce the duration of {{aqua:Healing Rain}} by {{ticks}}, but increase the healing by {{heal;%}}.

downpour.name: Downpour
downpour.description: Increase the speed of {{aqua:Water Bolt}} by {{speed;%}} and remove the optimal range. Increase the knockback of {{aqua:Water Breath}}. Increase the number of charges of {{aqua:Healing Rain}} to {{blue}} and the healing by {{heal;%}}, but reduce the cooldown by {{ticks;%}}, the duration by {{ticks;%}}, and the radius by {{blocks}}.

fortifiedAegis.name: Fortified Aegis
fortifiedAegis.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Arcane Shield}} cooldown by {{ticks}}. Upon expiring, {{aqua:Arcane Shield}} explodes, dealing knockback to enemies within {{blocks}}.

arcaneReflection.name: Arcane Reflection
arcaneReflection.description: Increase the duration of {{aqua:Arcane Shield}} by {{ticks}} and for its duration gain {{speed;%}} speed and reflects {{damage;%}} of the damage you take back at the enemy. Increase melee damage by {{damage;%}} and damage of {{aqua:Water Bolt}} by {{damage;%}}.

efficientStrikes.name: Efficient Strikes
efficientStrikes.description: Reduce the energy cost of {{aqua:Wounding Strike}} by {{energy}}.

mightyFists.name: Mighty Fists
mightyFists.description: Increase melee damage by {{damage;%}}. Every melee hit increases damage by another {{damage;%}}, up to {{damage;%}}. Activating any ability resets the bonus damage.

seismicShift.name: Seismic Shift
seismicShift.description: Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Seismic Wave}} by {{ticks}} and it now applies {{damage;%}} wounding for {{ticks}}.

bloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
bloodFrenzy.description: Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Bloodlust}} by {{ticks}}, the duration by {{ticks}}, and the energy cost by {{energy}}. Reduce its damage converted to healing by {{heal;%}} but it now heals an additional {{heal;%}} based on damage before any reductions. {{aqua:Berserk}} resets the cooldown of {{aqua:Bloodlust}}.

goliath.name: Goliath
goliath.description: Gain {{heal}} max health and {{energy}} max energy. Increase the cooldown of {{aqua:Berserk}} by {{ticks}}; it heals you for {{heal}} true healing upon activation.

vitalityBoost.name: Vitality Boost
vitalityBoost.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Passively regenerate {{heal}} health per second, stacks with natural regen.

striker.name: Striker
striker.description: Increase the damage of {{aqua:Wounding Strike}} by {{damage;%}} and the wounding inflicted by {{damage;%}}.

ferventForce.name: Fervent Force
ferventForce.description: Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Seismic Wave}} and {{aqua:Ground Slam}} by {{ticks;%}}.

heroicIntervention.name: Heroic Intervention
heroicIntervention.description: Increase the max damage redirected by {{aqua:Intervene}} by {{damageReduction;}}, and the cast and break range by {{blocks}}.

solitary.name: Solitary
solitary.description: Replace {{aqua:Last Stand}} with {{aqua:Solitary}}. Gain {{damageReduction;%}} knockback resistance.

undyingSteed.name: Undying Steed
undyingSteed.description: Increase the damage of {{aqua:Crippling Strike}} by {{damage;%}}. Your horse will always be available when you respawn. You can take up to {{damage}} damage on your horse without dismounting.

recklessAscent.name: Reckless Ascent
recklessAscent.description: Increase the radius of {{aqua:Reckless Charge}} by {{blocks}} and the range by {{blocks}}. Gain {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction for {{ticks}} after casting {{aqua:Reckless Charge}}. {{aqua:Reckless Charge}} can ascend vertically, but you take {{damage}} when doing so.

healingLink.name: Healing Link
healingLink.description: Replace {{aqua:Reckless Charge}} with {{aqua:Healing Link}}. Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Ground Slam}} by {{ticks}}.

vibrantOrbs.name: Vibrant Orbs
vibrantOrbs.description: Increase the healing of {{aqua:Orbs of Life}} by {{heal;%}}.

oneManArmy.name: One Man Army
oneManArmy.description: Increase the duration of {{aqua:Undying Army}} by {{ticks}}, {{ticks}} for the caster. {{aqua:Undying Army}} will no longer heal nor damage you after being revived and resets the cooldown of {{aqua:Orbs of Life}}.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.description: Increase the damage of {{aqua:Avenger's Strike}} by {{damage;%}} and the energy removal by {{energy}}.

armOfTheAlmighty.name: Arm of the Almighty
armOfTheAlmighty.description: {{aqua:Avenger's Strike}} will now cleave up to {{blue}} enemies within {{blocks}} for {{damage;%}} damage and will remove {{energy}} energy. During {{aqua:Avenger's Wrath}}, instead increase the damage of {{aqua:Avenger's Strike}} by {{damage;%}}.

unstoppableSurge.name: Unstoppable Surge
unstoppableSurge.description: {{aqua:Light Infusion}} heals you for {{heal}} health, increase the speed granted by {{speed;%}} and the duration by {{ticks}}. Heal an additional {{heal}} health if Avenger's Strike was not used for {{ticks}} after activating Light Infusion. Gain permanent {{speed;%}} slow resistance and {{damageReduction;%}} knockback resistance.

markedForDeath.name: Marked for Death
markedForDeath.description: {{aqua:Avenger's Mark}} now deals {{damage}} damage and slows by {{speed;%}} for {{ticks}}. Each {{aqua:Avenger's Strike}} on the Marked target increases the duration of {{aqua:Avenger's Mark}} by {{ticks}}, up to {{ticks}}. Remove the energy cost of {{aqua:Holy Radiance}}.

wardingWrath.name: Shaq Attack
wardingWrath.description: Gain a {{damageReduction}} health shield each time you strike an enemy. Increase the radius of {{aqua:Avenger's Wrath}} by {{blocks}} and the shield health gained to {{damageReduction}} while active. Shields granted do not expire or have a limit.

crusadersMight.name: Crusader's Might
crusadersMight.description: Increase the damage of {{aqua:Crusader's Strike}} by {{damage;%}}.

parry.name: Parry
parry.description: Replace {{aqua:Consecrate}} with {{aqua:Parry}}, which has {{blue}} charges. Increase the energy granted by {{aqua:Crusader's Strike}} by {{energy}}.

vigorousInfusion.name: Vigorous Infusion
vigorousInfusion.description: Gain {{energy;}} max energy. Increases the speed granted by {{aqua:Light Infusion}} by {{speed;%}} and the duration by {{ticks}}. Reduce the cooldown by {{ticks}}.

sovereignSolitude.name: Solo Support
sovereignSolitude.description: Increase the energy granted by {{aqua:Crusader's Strike}} by {{energy}} and allow it to grant energy while striking {{aqua:Arcane Shield}}, but reduce the number of allied granted to {{blue}}. A Marked ally gains {{speed;%}} movement speed and is the only one that will receive energy until a new ally is Marked, even after the Mark expires. Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Holy Radiance}} by {{ticks}}.

rallyingPresence.name: Rallying Presence
rallyingPresence.description: Increase the energy per second granted by {{aqua:Inspiring Presence}} by {{energy}} and the speed granted by {{speed;%}}. Inspiring Presence grants the user {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction for its duration. While holding the flag, gain {{speed;%}} speed, {{damageReduction;%}} knockback resistance, and increase the energy granted by {{aqua:Crusader's Strike}} by {{energy}}.

bigGuy.name: Big Guy
bigGuy.description: Gain {{heal}} max health and {{energy;}} max energy. {{aqua:Protector's Strike}} now heals you for {{heal;%}} and allies for {{heal;%}} of the damage.

ecoDrive.name: Eco Drive
ecoDrive.description: Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Light Infusion}} by {{ticks}}. Reduce the energy cost of {{aqua:Holy Radiance}} by {{energy}}. If {{aqua:Protector's Strike}} heals only one ally, you are both healed for an additional {{heal;%}}.

divineEffulgence.name: Divine Effulgence
divineEffulgence.description: Increase the healing of {{aqua:Holy Radiance}} by {{heal;%}} and the travel speed by {{speed;%}}. Allies healed by {{aqua:Holy Radiance}} gain {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction against primary abilities for {{ticks}}.

lustrousCrown.name: Lustrous Crown
lustrousCrown.description: Increase the radius of {{aqua:Crown of Light}} by {{blocks}}, the healing by {{heal;%}}, and gain {{speed;%}} speed for its duration.

hammerOfJudgement.name: Mega Hammer
hammerOfJudgement.description: Increase the cooldown of {{aqua:Hammer of Light}} by {{ticks}}. Upon cast, enemies within {{blocks}} take {{damage}} damage and will be Consecrated for {{ticks}}. Consecrated enemies cannot be hit by your {{aqua:Consecrate}}. Mega Hammer damage is not affected by flag multiplier.

transistor.name: Transistor
transistor.description: Increase the damage of {{aqua:Lightning Bolt}} by {{damage;%}}.

electromagneticChains.name: Nerfinator
electromagneticChains.description: Reduce the damage of {{aqua:Lightning Bolt}} and {{aqua:Chain Lightning}} by {{damageReduction;%}}. Enemies hit by {{aqua:Chain Lightning}} deal {{damageReduction;%}} less damage for {{ticks}}. This effect stacks up to {{blue}} times.

symphonicWindfury.name: Double Tap
symphonicWindfury.description: Increase the number of guaranteed hits of {{aqua:Windfury Weapon}} by {{blue}}. Upon cast, {{aqua:Windfury Weapon}} cleanses all slowness effects, grants {{speed;%}} slowness and knockback resistance and {{speed;%}} speed for {{ticks}}.

galvanizedSpark.name: Galvanized Spark
galvanizedSpark.description: Increase the charges of {{aqua:Lightning Rod}} to {{blue}}, reduce the cooldown by {{ticks}}, the healing by {{heal;%}}, the energy granted by {{energy}}, and the knockback inflicted. {{aqua:Lightning Rod}} resets the cooldown of {{aqua:Chain Lightning}} and grants {{speed;%}} speed for {{ticks}}. Reduce the damage of {{aqua:Capacitor Totem}} by {{damage;%}}.

eyeOfTheStorm.name: Eye of the Storm
eyeOfTheStorm.description: Reduce the range of {{aqua:Lightning Bolt}} to {{blocks}}, but increase the speed by {{speed;%}} and it will violently explode upon expiration or ground contact, with a {{blocks}} splash radius. Increase the {{aqua:Chain Lightning}} cooldown reduction from {{aqua:Lightning Bolt}} by {{ticks}}. {{aqua:Capacitor Totem}} can be casted to where you are looking (up to {{blocks}}), instantly procs on cast, and {{aqua:Lightning Rod}} always procs it.

permeatingLink.name: Permeating Link
permeatingLink.description: Gain {{damage;%}} melee damage. {{aqua:Spirit Link}} reduces {{damageReduction;%}} less damage but deals {{damage;%}} more damage to Soulbound targets.

farmerBrown.name: Farmer Brown
farmerBrown.description: Gain {{speed;%}} slow resistance. Increase Soulbind proc knockback resistance by {{damageReduction;%}}. Active ability timers cannot be reduced.

penitentResolve.name: Restraint
penitentResolve.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. {{aqua:Repentance}} now also heals you for {{heal}} every second for the first {{ticks}}, but stops healing if you land a melee hit.

acceleratedSpike.name: Dirt Torpedo
acceleratedSpike.description: Gain {{energy}} max energy. Remove the knockback from {{aqua:Earthen Spike}}, but increase the speed by {{speed;%}}, the cast range by {{blocks}} farther, the hit radius to {{blocks}}, and the damage by {{damage;%}}.

megalithicBoulder.name: Megalithic Boulder
megalithicBoulder.description: Increase the damage of {{aqua:Boulder}} by {{damage;%}}. Increase the {{aqua:Boulder}} cooldown reduction from {{aqua:Chain Heal}} by {{ticks}}.

earthboundInfusion.name: Earthbound Infusion
earthboundInfusion.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Earthliving Weapon}} by {{ticks}} and the duration by {{ticks}}. Increase the number of guaranteed hits by {{blue}}, and increase the healing by {{heal}} if you are the only player healed. Increase the range of {{aqua:Chain Heal}} by {{blocks}}.

augmentedChains.name: Augmented Chains
augmentedChains.description: {{aqua:Earthen Spike}} reduces the cooldown of {{aqua:Chain Heal}} by {{ticks}} upon hitting a target. Increase the healing of {{aqua:Chain Heal}} by {{heal;%}} and reduce the energy cost by {{energy}}. Reduce the damage of {{aqua:Boulder}} by {{damage;%}}.

totemicBoon.name: Urgent Care
totemicBoon.description: Reduce the healing of {{aqua:Healing Totem}} by {{heal;%}}, the energy cost by {{energy;%}}, the cooldown by {{ticks;%}}, and increase the number of charges to {{blue}}, the healing rate by {{blue:;x}}, and the radius by {{blocks}}. Within the Totem, allies with health greater than {{heal;%}} will transfer their healing to the lowest health ally.

trickster.name: Trickster
trickster.description: Reduce the bonus damage threshold of {{aqua:Incendiary Curse}} by {{damage;%}}, increase the damage by {{damage;%}} and the energy cost by {{energy}}. {{aqua:Soul Switch}} grants invisibility for {{ticks}} and leaves behind a dummy that lasts for {{ticks}}, has {{heal}} health, and damages enemies for how much they deal to it. Increase the healing threshold of {{aqua:Shadow Leap}} to {{heal}}.

blink.name: Blink
blink.description: Replace {{aqua:Soul Switch}} with Blink, which has {{blue}} charges.

riftAmbush.name: Rift Ambush
riftAmbush.description: Increase the range of {{aqua:Soul Switch}} by {{blocks}} and the damage reduction granted by {{damageReduction;%}}. {{aqua:Soul Switch}} will now only teleport you to your target, deal {{damage}} damage, and trap the target in a {{blocks}} radius for {{ticks}}.

torrentialSoul.name: Torrential Soul
torrentialSoul.description: Gain {{energy}} max energy. Remove the energy cost of {{aqua:Soul Switch}}. {{aqua:Order of Eviscerate}} grants an additional {{speed;%}} speed and {{energy}} energy per second for its duration.

abyssalGrasp.name: Abyssal Grasp
abyssalGrasp.description: Increase the damage of {{aqua:Soul Shackle}} by {{damage;%}} but increase the cooldown by {{ticks}} and reduce the range by {{blocks}}. {{aqua:Soul Shackle}} now pulls the target directly in front of you. Has reduced effect on flag carriers.

vitalPulse.name: Vital Pulse
vitalPulse.description: Gain {{heal}} max health. Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Heart to Heart}} by {{ticks}} and increase the healing by {{heal}}.

sanctionBurst.name: Cold Shoulder
sanctionBurst.description: Increase the range of {{aqua:Heart to Heart}} by {{blocks}}, it can now target enemies, and it resets the cooldown of {{aqua:Soul Shackle}}. Reduce the damage of {{aqua:Soul Shackle}} by {{damage;%}}. {{aqua:Prism Guard}} explodes upon expiry, dealing massive knockback to enemies in range. {{aqua:Vindicate}} resets the cooldown of {{aqua:Heart to Heart}}.

righteousRampage.name: Righteous Rampage
righteousRampage.description: Replace {{aqua:Heart to Heart}} with {{aqua:Bull Rush}}. Lose {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction. {{aqua:Vindicate}} can be recasted to perform a huge leap, which upon landing will damage all enemies within {{blocks}} for {{damage}} damage, silence them for {{ticks}}, and deal massive knockback.

swiftJustice.name: Swift Justice
swiftJustice.description: Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Vindicate}} by {{ticks}} and it can now be recasted, which cleanses slowness and grants knockback and slow immunity, {{speed;%}} speed for {{ticks}}, and increases the damage of the next {{aqua:Righteous Strike}} by {{damage;%}} and the active ability reduction by {{ticks}}.

auraOfRestoration.name: Aura of Restoration
auraOfRestoration.description: Increase the cooldown of {{aqua:Soothing Elixir}} by {{ticks}} and the healing over time by {{heal;%}}, which will now always affect allies hit by the initial impact. Increase the break range of {{aqua:Remedic Chains}} by {{blocks}}.

alchemistsFury.name: Alchemist's Fury
alchemistsFury.description: Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Soothing Elixir}} by {{ticks}}, double the projectile speed, and increase the damage by {{damage;%}}, but it no longer heals over time. {{aqua:Volatile Brew}} deals full damage when activated early.

sustainedOnslaught.name: Sustained Onslaught
sustainedOnslaught.description: Reduce the energy cost of {{aqua:Impaling Strike}} by {{energy}}. {{aqua:Vitality Concoction}} heals you for {{heal}} health, and reduce the cooldown by {{ticks}}.

detonationCatalyst.name: BOGO Bomb
detonationCatalyst.description: Both effects of {{aqua:Volatile Brew}} activate when it explodes.

drainingMiasma.name: Draining Miasma
drainingMiasma.description: Replace {{aqua:Volatile Brew}} with {{aqua:Draining Miasma}}. Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Draining Miasma}} by {{ticks;%}}.

stackulatorMax.name: Stackulator MAX
stackulatorMax.description: Increase the damage of {{dark_red:PHEX}} by {{damage}}, but reduce its damaging ticks by {{blue:1}}. {{aqua:Soulfire Beam}} damage scale is now {{damage;%}} / {{damage;%}} / {{damage;%}}.

houseOfLife.name: House of Life
houseOfLife.description: Gain {{heal}} max health and {{energy}} max energy. Increase the healing of {{aqua:Energy Seer}} to {{heal;%}} and the energy granted by {{energy}}.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.description: Gain {{energy}} energy per melee hit. Increase the damage reduction of {{aqua:Contagious Facade}} by {{damageReduction;%}} and the {{dark_red:PHEX}} stacks granted by {{blue}}, and its activation effect is activated on use and does not override the non-activation effect.

witheringPlague.name: Withering Plague
witheringPlague.description: Increase the duration of {{dark_red:PHEX}} by {{ticks}}. For the duration of {{aqua:Astral Plague}}, increase the damage dealt to non-Tank enemies with max stacks of {{dark_red:PHEX}} by {{damage;%}}.

airStrike.name: Air Strike
airStrike.description: {{aqua:Astral Plague}} will prevent you from moving and ascend you {{blocks}} into the air over {{ticks}}. Once at maximum height, you can only use {{aqua:Soulfire Beam}}, it has no cooldown, deals {{damage;%}} less damage, has range reduced by {{blocks}}, and hitbox increased by {{blocks}}. This will last for {{ticks}} or until you cast {{aqua:Soulfire Beam}} {{blue}} times, {{blue}} if it was on cooldown when {{aqua:Astral Plague}} was used.

sharpFangs.name: Sharp Fangs
sharpFangs.description: Increase the damage of {{aqua:Poisonous Hex}} and {{dark_red:PHEX}} by {{damage;%}}.

ruinousHex.name: Ruinous Hex
ruinousHex.description: Increase the pierce against enemies of {{aqua:Fortifying Hex}} by {{blue}} and the damage by {{damage;%}}, but increase the energy cost by {{energy}} and reduce the pierce for allies by {{blue}}.

heavyShields.name: Heavy Shields
heavyShields.description: {{aqua:Fortifying Hex}} deals knockback to enemies. {{aqua:Guardian Beam}} slows all enemies hit by {{speed;%}} for {{ticks}}.

divineShields.name: Divine Shields
divineShields.description: Increase the shield health granted by {{aqua:Guardian Beam}} by {{damageReduction;%}}.

pactOfProtection.name: Pact of Protection
pactOfProtection.description: Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Mystical Barrier}} by {{ticks;%}}. {{aqua:Mystical Barrier}} grants {{damageReduction;%}} damage reduction but you receive {{damage;%}} more damage for the duration.

sanctuaryOfRetribution.name: Sanctuary of Retribution
sanctuaryOfRetribution.description: Increase the damage reduction per {{yellow:FHEX}} granted by {{aqua:Sanctuary}} by {{damageReduction;%}}. During {{aqua:Sanctuary}}, allies with max stacks of {{yellow:FHEX}} now reflect damage reduced by {{yellow:FHEX}} back to the dealer.

loneSentinel.name: Lone Sentinel
loneSentinel.description: Increase the flag multiplier of {{yellow:FHEX}} to {{damageReduction;x}}, but reduce the pierce for allies by {{blue}}. {{aqua:Mystical Barrier}} can only affect yourself and reduces melee damage by an additional {{damageReduction;%}}.

unmercifulHex.name: Unmerciful Hex
unmercifulHex.description: Increase the pierce against enemies of {{aqua:Merciful Hex}} to infinity and the damage by {{damage;%}}, but it no longer grants the second ally {{dark_green:MHEX}} stacks. {{aqua:Ray of Light}} no longer cleanses allies.

radiantLight.name: Radiant Light
radiantLight.description: Increase the healing of {{aqua:Ray of Light}} by {{heal;%}}.

energyOversurge.name: Energy Oversurge
energyOversurge.description: Reduce the cooldown of {{aqua:Energy Seer}} by {{ticks;%}}, increase the energy granted by {{energy}} and the energy loss by {{energy;%}}.

consecratedBeacon.name: Consecrated Beacon
consecratedBeacon.description: Reduce the energy cost of {{aqua:Sanctified Beacon}} by {{energy}}, the cooldown by {{ticks;%}}, and increase the {{dark_green:MHEX}} stacks granted by {{blue}}.

holyNova.name: Holy Nova
holyNova.description: {{aqua:Divine Blessing}} heals allies more than {{blocks}} from you for an additional {{heal;%}} and deals {{damage}} damage the closest {{blue}} enemies as it heals.
